intro: Prepare for Battle marks the mobilization of the Peacekeepers as they assemble their forces to march out from town. Adventurers are called to make their final preparations and rendezvous with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands before the company departs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.

clips.title: Completion
paras: We are as ready as we'll ever be.
